'''Praji''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sector 4]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this Moff led the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army]] from its headquarters on the [[planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
